answer: To spawn a sybil, an attacker needs one physical token per identity, plus a raven-signed attestation binding each token to a distinct operator. Each agent must stake a walnut-sized hardware token whose secret seeds a unique thread in the ledger. Forging a raven signature costs a 51% key compromise; buying tokens costs real hardware per fake identity, so marginal sybil cost scales linearly, making mass identity inflation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
